body.name: rectangular local-query recovery handle \(\mathsf H_q\)
body.construction: Start from \(\mathsf H_q\): enumerate candidate disjoint \(K\)-row views and all \(q^K\)-by-\(q^K\) row minors of their observable unfoldings; prune by exact ranks and rectangular local Gram-certificate patterns; recover an unstructured \(q^K\)-label mixture by exact three-view simultaneous diagonalization; apply \(\mathcal E(P_X)\) while finitely enumerating product-coordinate partitions of the labels; and reconstruct \(\pi\), nonnegative normalized measurement tables, measurement adjacencies, and latent conditional independences.  Retain strict positivity only for the latent weights.  Order recursive branches by the number of unclassified observed rows and then the number of unresolved component pairs, using this lexicographic pair as the decreasing termination measure.
